title: Transparent Inventory Window
description: Changes the window of Player, Horse, Nautilus and Creative to transparent. Dark UI available. NEW! Support for Inventory Extended.
body:
## No Dark Inventory Overlay is now requiered for +26.2!

Get it here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/no-dark-inventory-overlay

~~~~
~~~~

## Dark UI version is based on Vanilla Tweaks (c)
Get it here: https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/

**(Put Dark UI below Dark Transparent Inventory Window in the Resource Pack screen)**

~~~~
~~~~

## Inventory Extended Dark UI version
Get it here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/inventory-extended-dark-ui

The Mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-extended

~~~~
~~~~

## Extra Inventory version
Get it here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/extra-inventory-patch

The Mod: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/extra-inventory

~~~~
~~~~

**Transparent Inventory Window** changes the following 4 files:
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\horse.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\inventory.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\nautilus.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\creative_inventory\tab_inventory.png

**Dark Transparent Inventory Window** changes the following 4 files:
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\horse.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\inventory.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\nautilus.png
> 
> assets\minecraft\textures\gui\container\creative_inventory\tab_inventory.png

**(Blue background from the gallery images comes from the sky)**

~~~~
~~~~
